comments.author: Mar
comments.body_html:
I would really appreciate help with the settings in this mod to make it work exactly like vanilla or as close as possible. The reason is all I really wanted was a fix for a problem with recoil on certain sights such as the HHS-1. In vanilla the 1x mode of these certain sights would jump twice as much as the actual recoil so the sight would be aiming higher than the actual point of impact under full auto. This mod completely fixes that problem and it’s the only way I can find to fix it.

So far I figured out that I can get on the right track by enabling “Use 1.7.2 Recoil Values”, setting the Real Recoil Vertical to 2.0 and Horizontal to 0.7 per the tooltip for the 1.7.2 values option, and enabling Alternate Real Recoil. Unfortunately recoil actually seems quite toned down compared to vanilla from here; testing at the firing range shows me patterns that are significantly smaller than vanilla and it just sort of feels like cheating to me. Unfortunately the rest of the settings are quite complex to me and don’t seem to do what I expect them to, so I could really use some help.
